headline: Four people are k!lled and seventeen others injured in Oman after bus crashes into lorry
label: NEWS
caption:
A tragic road accident in Oman leaves multiple families devastated. 🚌

According to The National and Gulf News, four people were k!lled and 17 others were injured after a bus collided with a lorry in Oman.

Authorities and emergency services responded to the scene to assist the victims of the crash.
